svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: One pillar, every layer: a night's sleep from the ring to readiness (working names)
Data flows up. Example numbers for one night. Blue = the route used tonight; dashed grey = other sources that would fill the same boxes.
a subtotal: the points of its scores added up
each score's points possible; earned = score × points ÷ 100
each value compared with your normal or a research band → 0–100
raw data put into our standard format, whatever the source
every 5 min tagged deep, light, REM or awake
deep 1 h 05 · REM 1 h 40 · light 3 h 55 · awake 22 m
values exactly as each source sends them
→ stages worked out on the phone
the device or app the data comes in from
Points possible = the score's weight in its pillar × the pillar's share of readiness (Duration: 30% of Sleep × 30 = 9). Readiness is the sum
of every score's points earned. A score with no data drops out of the sum, and the other scores in its pillar share its points: if
Deep + REM had no data, Sleep = 7,890 ÷ 90 = 87.7. Proposed later: a source-quality and a reliability factor that scale a weight down
for estimated or patchy data. Red edge on Duration = it can also act on readiness directly. Example numbers, not a real night.
